directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: a result is keyed by a file's content identity (1f: or 12:) and a kind the producer names; nothing lists kinds
writing the same value again changes nothing (value identity, BLAKE3 of the value's JSON)
a read by any identity of a file finds results kept under its other identities, the newest of each kind
only_if_absent refuses a replacement under any identity; a refused item names its index and why, the others are kept
one kind across every file is listed in identity order, at most a page limit and page_bytes of values
many files at once: {identity asked: value}; a fields read answers only the named fields, null when absent
how many results of each kind, kept by the writes themselves
merge changes only the named fields of the one result the file already has under any identity, null takes a field away, only_if_empty fills empty fields only
remove forgets one kind under exactly one identity
a caller has at most reads_at_once_per_caller reads open at once and is answered busy with retry_after_seconds
the bounds MAX_VALUE_BYTES 1500000, PAGE_BYTES 4000000, page limits 200/1000, MAX_WRITE 500, MAX_MANY 1000, 16 fields, 200 characters of produced_by
allowed_deltas: the namespace_results table becomes @account-files/results/<identity> (id = kind) plus @account-files/result-kinds/<kind> (id = identity) and @account-files/result-counts

the HTTP routes under /mcp/api/namespace/results become door operations (record_file_results, read_file_results, read_file_result_fields, list_file_results, read_file_results_many, merge_file_result, remove_file_result): no new route
a merge writes against the record version it read, so a concurrent writer conflicts instead of relying on a Durable Object's single thread
the caller of the read bound is named by the call's `caller` field instead of a user-agent header
slice-by-slice streaming of a value is dropped: a record store record is read whole and is bounded by max_value_bytes

the search triggers and feed, timeline, resultsWaiting, arrivedFrom, carry and countStep are dropped: features (search, the awareness reading, organization, side files) and a recount the counts kept from the first write do not need
banned_substitutions: a result kept outside the person's own account files
a second copy of a merged result under another identity
a list of kinds in engine code
